Alex (fin): FYI alert: apac-south-1 shows ~9800 untagged GPU-hrs in the last 8h (~$18.5k). Can someone confirm origin?
BillingBot: ALERT: Unattributed GPU usage detected. region=apac-south-1, gpu_hrs=9800, window=2026-03-22T22:00Z-2026-03-23T06:00Z. Export: s3://billing-exports/2026-03-23/apac-untagged-9800.csv
Priyanka (platform): Could be a platform CI burst. If it's platform-test noise we can absorb up to $8k from reserve this month. Need job IDs to backfill if ML ran it.
Jia (ml): It's from a long vision sweep we launched; cost_center wasn't set. Sorry 7 I'll produce a run-owner mapping and backfill tags.
Sara (ops): We can retro-tag the billing CSV and update ledger if you provide run_id -> owner mapping + timestamps. Ops needs an approver signal for any internal transfer.
Alex (fin): Proposal: Platform covers $8k now. Remaining ~$10.5k charged to ML R&D via internal invoice INT-2026-03145 unless finance approves a different split. Need a snippet showing run IDs and user emails. Include audit comment when posting.
Priyanka (platform): I approve the $8k platform cover. Priyanka (platform) :thumbsup:. Jia, drop mapping to s3 and run this query to list candidates:
```sql
SELECT run_id, user_email, gpu_hours, start_time FROM gpu_usage
WHERE region='apac-south-1' AND start_time >= '2026-03-22' AND cost_center IS NULL
ORDER BY gpu_hours DESC LIMIT 200;
```
Jia (ml): Mapping uploaded: s3://ml-logs/2026-03-22/vision-sweep-backfill.csv. I'll run the backfill now and add run metadata to the invoice.
BillingBot: NOTE: pending internal-transfer recorded: INT-2026-03145 (platform_cover=8000, ml_charge=10500).
Alex (fin): I provisionally approve the $10.5k charge to ML R&D contingent on the backfill artifacts and run-owner mapping being attached to the invoice. Please include ledger audit note: "retro-tagging for apac overnight sweep; platform reserve covered $8k; remaining charged to ML R&D." Closing thread when accounting confirms INT-2026-03145 posted. :white_check_mark:
